clients.name: Portia Grid
clients.shortDescription: A comprehensive web platform for managing delivery truck fleets and their maintenance schedules.
clients.fullDescription: Portia Grid is a powerful internal tool we built to help logistics companies manage their entire fleet of delivery trucks. From tracking vehicle locations to scheduling maintenance, everything is handled in one centralized dashboard.
clients.challenge: The client was managing 50+ delivery trucks using spreadsheets and phone calls. Maintenance was often missed, leading to breakdowns and delays. They had no visibility into their fleet's real-time status.
clients.solution: We built a custom web platform that provides real-time GPS tracking, automated maintenance scheduling based on mileage and time, driver assignment management, and comprehensive reporting.

testimonial.quote: Most devs just build what you tell them; this team actually thinks through the logic with you. Building Portia Grid required a lot of tactical intelligence and complex data handling, and Mohamed, Asad, and Ariyan absolutely nailed it. They've got great energy, they know their tech inside out, and they held my hand through the entire process. If you want a team that takes ownership of the outcome, this is it.
testimonial.author: Hassan

clients.name: Veeramangalam Juma Masjid Finance
clients.tagline: Masjid finance — cloud and offline in one
clients.shortDescription: Jamia System replaces Excel sheets and paper trails for mosque expenses and local contributions.
clients.fullDescription: We built Jamia System for Veeramangalam Juma Masjid Finance — a two-in-one platform on Firebase with full offline support. It replaces the Excel sheets and handwritten ledgers the community used to track expenses and local contributions.
clients.challenge: The masjid finance team tracked member contributions and operational expenses across spreadsheets and paper records. Reconciliation was slow, errors crept in, and nothing worked when the internet was down.
clients.solution: We built Jamia System — a Firebase-backed finance platform with offline-first sync. Contributions, expenses, and jamia ledgers live in one place, connected or not.
